description: This file defines the User class within the Opencart system, handling user authentication, permission management, and user data retrieval within the shopping cart component.

classes.name: User
classes.description: A class representing an authenticated user, with capabilities for login, logout, permission checks, and access to user details within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with username and password, updating session and permissions accordingly.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user, clearing user session data.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific permission for a given key and value.

methods.name: isLogged
methods.description: Returns whether a user is currently logged in.
